author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rejected drawing dropped the play triangle and the lens (a box sat under the house between two ticks), so it no longer read as a video hologram; redrawn with the house roof with eaves, a solid play mark inside the house, a lens ring resting on the projector base, and a light cone from the lens to the house floor corners. Checked 48px light/dark.
omissions: Play triangle drawn solid and smaller (an outlined one needs about 28 units of house height); side beams merged into a cone that touches the house; base drawn as a line instead of a pill.
